heading: Thursday, April 23, 2026
topLine: Reinforcement-learning design model yields an antibiotic effective in infected mouse wounds. Also: OpenAI releases GPT-5.5.

items.headline: Reinforcement-learning design model yields an antibiotic effective in infected mouse wounds
items.summary: McMaster's Stokes lab with Stanford collaborators built SyntheMol-RL, which searches a space of up to 46 billion easily synthesisable molecules, and proposed 79 antibacterials from which they selected synthecin, a water-soluble compound against Staphylococcus aureus. Published in Molecular Systems Biology: formulated as a topical cream, it controlled a drug-resistant wound infection in mouse models, though its mechanism of action is still unknown.

items.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-5.5
items.summary: GPT-5.5 is a frontier model positioned for agentic coding, computer use and knowledge work, launched in ChatGPT and Codex with API access on April 24 (1M context). OpenAI reports 82.7% on Terminal-Bench 2.0 and 58.6% on SWE-Bench Pro.
